t: Members Mark® Brand Official Website
s: December 2, 2023 - my senior golden retriever, Bailey, has always had a sensitive stomach. i've spent YEARS trying different premium dog foods, even those prescription ones from the vet that cost a fortune. nothing seemed to work consistently. i was at sam's club picking up supplies when i noticed the members mark dog food. honestly, i almost didn't give it a second glance (store brand dog food? really?). but the ingredient list caught my attention - actual meat first, no weird fillers, and it mentioned formulation for sensitive digestion. fast forward three months: bailey's coat is SHINING. her digestive issues have basically disappeared. she actually gets excited at mealtime now!!! her energy levels have improved noticeably, which our vet commented on at our last checkup. i'm literally saving $45 per month compared to what i was buying before, for what appears to be a superior product.
